body:
May12 P1-only now has certified global gap **0.0620078%**: full-domain LP LB **0.6588875395606518**, independently verified original integer UB **0.6592963546281192**. Phase-I artificial-free zero, 130-class complete STAY/migration pricing closure, original physical replay and the separate P1-only Freeze all pass. P2 and downstream stages were not run; the original four-objective A1 acceptance remains false.

The saved historical run had already reached Phi=0 and P1. Its activation failed when an artificial-free P1 point was incorrectly subjected to an artificial-weight equality check after support expansion changed 80 weights on 40 global rows. The actual saved-matrix regression reproduces this before repair. P1 activation now verifies original-point inclusion without artificials; the positive-Phi frozen-weight/sign guard and all original equations, objectives, types, candidate domains and tolerances remain intact.

The recovery reuses 285 historical solves, 192 verified concrete columns and 92 negative supports. Exact batch ledger construction, completed-pricing revalidation and immutable activation checkpoints reduce repeated Python work. S0 and S1 each complete all 130 original class oracles (208,957 STAY and 50,756,904 migration paths); S1 closes with no negative block. An additional 39,993 exact-negative STAY columns were verified in a shadow full-matrix comparison but were not needed for activation.

Validation includes 389 A-stage/recovery tests, 22 focused execution/cache tests, 16 post-run accounting/acceptance/JSON identity tests, and independent exact dyadic replay of the saved 3,184,901-row / 1,141,597-column integer model with integrality residual zero and original physical checks for 1,782 jobs. Source epochs 1–8, original input files and 47 grid arrays, native RAW/matrix receipts and historical bytes verify unchanged. Initial failed regression and serialization checks are retained with their corrections.

There were 261 new sequential native calls, Runtime **208.870002s** / 3,600s and Work **180.850507**, Threads=1, with no finite memory limits or RAM-triggered stops. The integer solve used 173.380s and ended at status 11 because the independently validated target gap triggered termination. The final resumed run wall was 662.308s; cumulative attempted-run wall was 4,009.185s, so the full 60-minute practicality criterion fails. Scientific acceptance and practical wall-time acceptance are reported separately.

The branch directly descends from actual historical May12 source HEAD 1b891dbe5b1dd454d89b657efec7cba469c0cf94, including its unpublished local changes after PR181. PR181 and PR184 are preserved. All required reports/certificates are under docs/v42_may12_p1_exact_rescue_20261008/. Large binary payloads remain on D: with SHA256 receipts. No automatic follow-up is scheduled.
